hook: Pregabalin dispensing and overdose calls in Australia fell after media coverage and prescribing limits
hook_turn: fell after media coverage and prescribing limits
summary: Pregabalin use and overdose calls in Australia peaked around 2018 and then declined, with trend breaks matching media coverage, 2020 restrictions and 2021 boxed warnings. The authors used changepoint and interrupted time series analysis of a 10% dispensing sample and Poisons Centre calls. Because this is observational, the timing fits the interventions but does not prove they caused the drop.
title: Changes in pregabalin use and overdose after government interventions and media coverage: retrospective observational study.
